Area C - SFOW.description:
Area C Sectors: 

Grove (3G): Grove is an arrival sector that works traffic inbound to OAK. It also works traffic departing LVK. 

Sunol (3S): Sunol is an arrival sector that sequences traffic inbound to OAK, SMF and other Bay Area airports. 

Valley (3Y): Valley is a low altitude sector that works traffic into and out of SCK. 

Castle (3K): Castle is a low altitude sector that works traffic into and out of MER, MCE and MOD. 

Tracy (3J): Tracy is a low altitude sector that works traffic into and out of LVK, TCY and SCK. It is usually combined with Valley. 

Mulford (3M): Mulford is a finals sector responsible for the OAK Rwy 30 and HWD finals during SFOW, and the OAK Rwy 12 final during OAKE/SFOE.
